testcase.system-out: Scenario: rectangle-two-point-13 Accept and undo a rectangle height edit ✔ Given the recorded Right-view sketch contains the overlapping ellipse and a rectangle annotated 6 mm high by 4 mm wide, with its height edit active ✔ When the user accepts height 8 mm and exits General Dimension ✔ Then the height annotation shows 8 and the width annotation remains 4 ✔ When the user opens Measure and selects the left edge ✔ Then Measure reports the selected left edge length as 8.000 mm ✔ When the user closes Measure and undoes the height edit ✔ Then the visible height annotation returns to 6 ✔ When the user redoes the height edit ✔ Then the visible height annotation returns to 8 ✔ And width annotation 4 remains
